players.bio: Albert George Eames (born 20 December 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Watford.
Alessio Dionisi (born 1 April 1980) is an Italian professional football coach and former player who is currently the head coach of EFL Championship club Watford.

Amin Nabizada (Dari: امین نبی‌زاده; born 21 June 2007) is a professional footballer who plays for the EFL Championship club Watford as a forward. Born in England, he plays for the Afghanistan national team.
Branimir Mlačić (born 12 March 2007) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Watford, on loan from Serie A club Udinese.

Daniel Bachmann (born 9 July 1994) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Watford. Bachmann began his professional career with Stoke City in 2011. During his time at Stoke, he gained first-team experience by going out on loan to Wrexham, Ross County and Bury. Bachmann moved to Watford in 2017 and spent the following season on loan at Kilmarnock.
Edouard Kayembe (born 3 June 1998) is a Congolese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Watford and the DR Congo national team.
Edoardo Bove (born 16 May 2002) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for English EFL Championship club Watford.
Federico Ravaglia (born 11 November 1999) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Watford.

Hector Matthew Kyprianou (Greek: Έκτορ Ματθαίος Κυπριανού; born 27 May 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or centre-back for EFL Championship club Watford. Born in England, he plays for the Cyprus national team.
Iker Bravo Solanilla (born 13 January 2005) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Watford.
Jack Alexander Grieves (born 5 December 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Watford.
Jeremy Mpobi Ngakia (born 7 September 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Watford.

Jordan Bhekithemba Zemura (born 14 November 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Watford on loan from Serie A club Udinese. Born in England, Zemura represents the Zimbabwe national team. Early life Zemura went to the Oasis Academy Isle of Sheppey for secondary school and went on to study Sport Science at Canterbury University.
Kévin Xavier Keben Biakolo (born 26 January 2004) is a Cameroonian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Watford and the Cameroon national team.
Krépin Diatta (born 25 February 1999) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a wing-back for the Senegal national team and EFL Championship side Watford.

Kwadwo Kyeremeh Baah (born 27 January 2003) is a German professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for EFL Championship club Watford. Having played for Germany internationally at youth level, He has also represented the England U18 national team.
Luca Tange Kjerrumgaard (born 9 February 2003) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Watford.
Mamadou Doumbia (born 18 February 2006) is a Malian professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Watford and the Mali national team.
Marc Joel Bola (born 9 December 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left back for EFL Championship club Watford.
Martín Ismael Payero (born 11 September 1998) is an Argentinian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL Championship club Watford.

Mattie William Pollock (born 28 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Watford. Pollock was the product of the youth academies of Middlesbrough and Leeds United before joining Grimsby Town's academy in 2018.

Michail Gregory Antonio (born 28 March 1990) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Watford and the Jamaica national team. Antonio began his career at non-League club Tooting & Mitcham United before signing with Reading of the Championship in 2008.

Myron Kwasi Koomson Boadu (born 14 January 2001) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Watford. A product of the AZ academy, Boadu became the club's youngest Eredivisie goalscorer and broke into the first team during the 2019–20 season, scoring in the league and in AZ's Europa League campaign.
Nikoloz Chikovani (Georgian: ნიკოლოზ ჩიქოვანი; born 21 June 2007) is a Georgian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Watford.
Omar Haktab Traoré (born 4 February 1998) is a German professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Watford.
Othmane Maamma (born 6 October 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Watford. Born in France, he represents the Morocco national team.
Rocco Vata (born 18 April 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Watford. Born in Scotland, he represents the Republic of Ireland national team.

Samuel Colin Walker (born 2 October 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship side Watford. Walker progressed through the youth ranks at Millwall and Chelsea, although he failed to make an appearance for either club. He was loaned from Chelsea to Barnet, Northampton Town, Yeovil Town, Bristol Rovers and Colchester United on two occasions.
Soumaïla Coulibaly (born 14 October 2003) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Watford, on loan from Ligue 1 club Strasbourg.

Stephy Alvaro Mavididi (born 31 May 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for EFL Championship club Watford, on loan from Leicester City. Born in England, he represents the DR Congo national team.
